Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Kerrie
Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Melee weapon. Requires a Laibon.
Strength +1 damage each strike.
Alternatively, inflict strength damage as a strike and,
after strike resolution, turn this weapon face down (out of play)
until the end of the action.

***

Interesting.
Prevent it from being stolen after you use it (or used after it's
stolen), and keep it inactive through Psyche etc.

If its ranged ability is used, it still counts as a Melee Weapon, so you
can do "Kerrie of the Righteous" at long range, and other similar
tricks, if I'm reading it correctly... LSJ?

Another question:
If the vampire with this weapon uses it, but is then torporized and
diablerized with Amaranth, what happens to the Kerrie? Can it be taken,
or does it simply move to the ash heap (or stay out of game)?

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:

> If its ranged ability is used, it still counts as a Melee Weapon, so you
> can do "Kerrie of the Righteous" at long range, and other similar
> tricks, if I'm reading it correctly... LSJ?

I need to clarify this question a little bit.
Sword of the Righteous is very clear about its effect. Choose a melee
weapon, and that weapon's damage is aggravated, and it never checks if
it's a melee weapon again.

But there are other effects which are less clear:

Elihu/Jaroslav: If there were some theoretical way for one of them to
become Laibon, would Kerrie inflict +2 damage at long range?
Similar question for Blessing of the Name, and other "increase the damage
from melee weapons" effects.
Hell, does this make Twisting the Knife playable at long range?

Undead Strength: You probably can't use Undead Strength with Kerrie at
Long Range, because it is a non-ranged strike by US's card text. But
since this is a new effect, I figured I would ask.

Messages.Author: HardyRange
Messages.Body:
>
> Elihu/Jaroslav: If there were some theoretical way for one of them to
> become Laibon, would Kerrie inflict +2 damage at long range?

You do not need to make those vamps Laibon. The Kerrie just requires a
Laibon to bring it into play. It may then be used by any vampire.

You can always use Heidelberg Castle, Nod,, or just the good old action
to equip with equipment currently on one of your other minions to move
the Kerrie over to Jaroslav.

Hardy Range

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> If its ranged ability is used, it still counts as a Melee Weapon, so you
> can do "Kerrie of the Righteous" at long range, and other similar
> tricks, if I'm reading it correctly... LSJ?
>
> Another question:
> If the vampire with this weapon uses it, but is then torporized and
> diablerized with Amaranth, what happens to the Kerrie? Can it be taken,
> or does it simply move to the ash heap (or stay out of game)?

It is a melee weapon, so counts as one for all effects that look for one.

When it is out of play, it will not be found by effects that look for it.

(So if out of play when its bearer is diablerized, it stays out of
play or goes to the ash heap. A quick check for the obvious parallel
of a contested equipment on a diablerie victim yields: "ash heap" as
the answer to that question:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/723875f3607837d8
)
